note: Large private RV park at 7445 Blythe Island Hwy, Brunswick (Golden Isles), right off I-95. Pool, on-site pub and grill, dog wash, game room, playground and a stocked pond; cabins and RV rentals too. Transient nightly plus long-term sites. --Claude
summary: Operator site live (phone 912-261-1025 matches) with a public BookMySites engine: Legacy sites (to 30 ft) $53.94, Premier concrete $73, same weekday/weekend Nov 2026-Jun 2027; 335 RV sites, pull-throughs, full hookups, showers/laundry/Wi-Fi, books a year ahead. Cleared the 85-ft max (note prose; operator states only 30 ft for Legacy and '30 x 70' sites'). Amperage beyond '30 Amp' types not stated, so electric left unset. Good Sam/military left as derived (operator silent). Pin at the office, inside the park.
flags: GATE: cheapest RV night $53.94 (Legacy site, operator's engine, 2026-11 to 2027-06, no weekend premium) is over US$50, but this is a Good Sam Park (directory isGsPark): at 10% off = $48.55, under $50 - passes only on the Good Sam discount. No gateway within 40 km (Jacksonville 91 km); family has not stayed. Presence passes (live website + phone + public booking engine).

LONG-STAY share: the engine separates 'Legacy Long-Term' (65) and 'Legacy Long-Term 30 Amp' (26) site types from the transient ones - 91 of 335 sites (27%) are long-term; the rest sell single nights online. Passes tests 2 and 4.

WATERFRONT lead: the engine sells 15 'Premier Back-Ins (Water View)' sites ($73); imagery shows a small pond (~70 x 50 m) beside the big Premier concrete lot west of the office. Stored 'not waterfront' - re-run the gate on those pads (a retention-type pond).
